explicit_requirements: Replace the current profile display name with nonblank text, removing surrounding whitespace before storing it.
Return the stored normalized display name, and update the caller-owned profile rather than merely echoing input.
Allow free-form display labels without uniqueness, vocabulary or format restrictions.
Reject non-string, empty and whitespace-only names without changing the stored name.

scenarios.name: Store and return the normalized display name
scenarios.behavior: A valid name replaces the current profile name after surrounding whitespace is removed; the returned name matches the stored normalized value.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires normalization before storage, actual record update and returning the stored value.

scenarios.name: Reject invalid names without changing the stored name
scenarios.behavior: Non-string, empty and whitespace-only input is rejected while the previously stored display name remains unchanged.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly pairs invalid-input rejection with preservation of the stored name.

scenarios.name: Preserve unrelated profile fields
scenarios.behavior: Changing the display name leaves every other existing profile field unchanged.
scenarios.reason: The task directly requires preservation of the profile's other fields.

scenarios.name: Accept free-form nonblank display labels
scenarios.behavior: Nonblank display labels are accepted without imposing an account-identity lookup, uniqueness rule, prescribed vocabulary or format.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly distinguishes free-form display labels from account identifiers and disclaims these restrictions.
